name: stremio-skip-addon
description: A self-hosted Stremio stream addon that cuts intro, recap, credits and preview segments out of HLS streams using TheIntroDB timings.
author: TheIntroDB

TIDB_API_KEY.description: Optional [TheIntroDB API key](https://theintrodb.org/docs). Anonymous lookups are rate limited per IP on the shared Cloudflare egress addresses, so a key is strongly recommended for a deployed Worker. Leave empty to run anonymously.
